title: Table Export for Grafana
imageAlt: Table Export for Grafana graphic: a Grafana Explore query result with the Export menu open, listing Markdown, CSV, TSV, JSON and plain-text formats
description: *Table Export for Grafana* is a **Chrome extension** for Grafana Explore. It adds an **Export** button above each result table that exports the full result, not only the rows on screen, as **Markdown**, **CSV**, **TSV**, **JSON** or a plain-text table.
Copy it, or download a file. It works at once on **Grafana Cloud**, and any other Grafana turns on with one click. Nothing leaves the browser.
It is not in the Chrome Web Store yet. Install it from the [latest release](https://github.com/guplem/grafana-table-export/releases/latest).
